summary: The solver successfully explored the codebase, identified the relevant files (policies/gitlab/repository.rego, test/repository_test.go), and made edits to add the policy and test. However, the policy logic was inverted (policy returns false when input.restrict_user_defined_variables is true, but should return false when the field is false). The solver ran the test, observed the failure, but the session ended before the fix could be completed. The oracle verifier correctly identified the same behavioral failure.
